title.zh: SEC工作人员在新FAQ中就代币回购和流动性质押划定界限 - The Defiant
title.en: SEC Staff Draws A Line On Token Buybacks and Liquid Staking in New FAQs - The Defiant

current_state.zh: SEC 工作人员于 2026 年 9 月 25 日发布 FAQ 指引，说明成熟网络可回购非证券代币且不因此单独触发 Howey；背景是截至 2026 年 8 月代币回购达创纪录约 6.38 亿美元，Hyperliquid 和 Pump.fun 占近 90%。
current_state.en: SEC staff issued FAQs on Sept 25, 2026 clarifying mature networks can buy back non-security tokens without that alone triggering Howey; amid record 2026 token buybacks of about $638M through August, with Hyperliquid and Pump.fun accounting for nearly 90%.

updates.title_zh: 加密代币回购规模创下6.38亿美元纪录，SEC扫清监管障碍
updates.title_en: SEC clears regulatory hurdle as crypto token buybacks hit record $638 million
updates.what_changed_zh: SEC 工作人员 FAQ 明确：成熟网络回购非证券代币本身不触发 Howey；同时数据显示截至 2026 年 8 月加密代币回购达创纪录约 6.38 亿美元，Hyperliquid 与 Pump.fun 占近 90%。
updates.what_changed_en: SEC staff FAQs specified mature networks can buy back non-security tokens without that alone triggering Howey; market data showed record 2026 token buybacks of about $638M through August, with Hyperliquid and Pump.fun accounting for nearly 90%.
updates.current_state_zh: SEC 工作人员于 2026 年 9 月 25 日发布 FAQ 指引，说明成熟网络可回购非证券代币且不因此单独触发 Howey；背景是截至 2026 年 8 月代币回购达创纪录约 6.38 亿美元，Hyperliquid 和 Pump.fun 占近 90%。
updates.current_state_en: SEC staff issued FAQs on Sept 25, 2026 clarifying mature networks can buy back non-security tokens without that alone triggering Howey; amid record 2026 token buybacks of about $638M through August, with Hyperliquid and Pump.fun accounting for nearly 90%.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: SEC staff guidance issued Sept. 25 held that mature networks can buy back non-security tokens without that alone triggering Howey, against a backdrop of record crypto token buybacks of roughly $638 million through August 2026, nearly 90% of it from Hyperliquid and Pump.fun.
updates.detailed_summary_en: SEC staff guidance issued Sept. 25 held that mature networks can buy back non-security tokens without that alone triggering Howey, against a backdrop of record crypto token buybacks of roughly $638 million through August 2026, nearly 90% of it from Hyperliquid and Pump.fun.
